title: Cloud Security Basics
subtitle: Shared responsibility, identity, data, platform, logging, and audit foundations
description: Ten reviewed Google Cloud Tech episodes on shared responsibility, access and data risks, platform and hardware controls, IAM, service accounts, security logging, and audit logs. The 2020–2021 product roles, defaults, interfaces, and procedures are historical context; current Google Cloud documentation remains the authority for implementation.

title: Getting Started with Cloud Security Command Center
subtitle: Five historical walkthroughs of scanning, detection, data protection, and security posture
description: Five reviewed 2019 walkthroughs covering Cloud Security Scanner, anomaly detection, Event Threat Detection, data-loss prevention, and Security Health Analytics. Use the collection to understand the detection and posture-management boundaries, not as current guidance for product editions, roles, detectors, interfaces, or remediation steps.

title: Serverless Expeditions — selected guide
subtitle: Fourteen episodes on service choice, architecture, scaling, state, security, operations, and delivery
description: A reviewed selection from Serverless Expeditions that moves from Cloud Run and functions through event ordering, relational state, workflow compensation, secrets, least privilege, infrastructure as code, alerting, and safe deployment. Two newer AI-agent examples form a fast-moving appendix rather than part of the stable serverless core.

title: Pub/Sub Made Easy
subtitle: A ten-episode progression through topics, subscriptions, clients, endpoints, and replay
description: Ten reviewed episodes that build a Pub/Sub mental model from topics and independent subscription state through publisher and subscriber behavior, push versus pull, serverless endpoints, and replay. The architectural principles remain useful, but the 2019–2020 limits, defaults, credentials, interfaces, and commands require current-documentation checks.

title: Pub/Sub Best Practices
subtitle: Publishing, subscribing, feature, latency, client-library, and testing trade-offs
description: Six reviewed episodes on publishing and subscription design, delivery features, regional latency and reliability, client-library behavior, experimentation, and testing. The series provides a compact decision framework while keeping its 2023 retention, limits, API behavior, performance, and pricing claims explicitly time-bounded.

title: Google Cloud Essentials — selected guide
subtitle: Eight concise orientations to compute, storage, containers, projects, delivery, logs, and errors
description: Eight reviewed Google Cloud Tech explainers on cloud orientation, compute and storage choices, container platforms, Firebase and Google Cloud projects, build tools, centralized logging, and error reporting. The collection emphasizes durable service-selection concepts while marking 2020–2022 product boundaries and procedures as historical.

title: Engineering for Reliability
subtitle: Twenty-three substantive episodes on SLOs, telemetry, alerting, investigation, and operations
description: Twenty-three reviewed episodes that connect user-centered SLIs and SLOs to metrics, logs, traces, alerting, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, quota headroom, GKE diagnosis, and observability cost. The learning sequence excludes the non-substantive trailer and treats all 2021–2022 interfaces, schemas, defaults, and pricing as historical.

title: Get Started with Google Cloud — selected guide
subtitle: Twelve practical entries spanning docs, networking, storage, IAM, cost, data, workflows, and APIs
description: A reviewed twelve-item route through quickstarts, VPCs, persistent disks, IAM, IAP, BigQuery cost and data patterns, object versioning, sensitive-data handling, Workflows, and Speech-to-Text. It preserves useful concepts while directing every 2018–2022 procedure to current product documentation.

title: Build With Google Cloud
subtitle: Five 2022 architecture snapshots for banking, commerce, edge, and social applications
description: Five reviewed architecture presentations covering Google Cloud orientation and example banking, e-commerce, restaurant-edge, and social-photo systems. The collection separates demonstrated behavior from proposed designs and treats service, partner, product, performance, and benefit claims as presenter or vendor snapshots from 2022.

title: Cloud Bytes — selected guide
subtitle: Twelve one-minute orientations across compute, data, operations, networking, and security
description: Twelve reviewed one-minute primers spanning Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Run, Storage, Spanner, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, BigQuery, observability, VPC, IAM, and VPC Service Controls. They form a compact service-choice map, not implementation guidance; historical names, behavior, limits, and pricing require current documentation.

title: Beyond Your Bill — selected guide
subtitle: Eleven episodes on resource ownership, billing analysis, budgets, commitments, and GKE efficiency
description: A reviewed eleven-item FinOps route through resource hierarchy, billing permissions, reports, exports, invoices, budgets, committed use, and four concrete GKE efficiency levers. Budgets are notifications rather than hard caps, and all 2019–2021 interfaces, policy details, pricing, and autoscaling mechanics are historical.

title: Architecting with Google Cloud — selected guide
subtitle: Ten case studies on scale, service boundaries, data platforms, machine learning, and security
description: Ten reviewed architecture case studies spanning global storage, bursty concurrency, microservices, media ingestion, analytical migration, low-latency ML, regulated healthcare, and security response. The guide extracts transferable patterns while attributing organization and vendor claims and requiring current technical and domain review for its 2021–2023 examples.
